title: Air Fryer Fried Okra
description: Fried okra made easy in an air fryer without the guilt or mess of a using deep fryer. They make a great vegetarian side dish to any meal.
ingredients: 0.5 pound okra pods, cut into 1/2-inch slices

steps.text: Place egg in a shallow dish and beat; gently stir in sliced okra.

Combine cornmeal and flour in a gallon-size resealable plastic bag. Drop 5 slices of okra in the cornmeal mixture, zip the bag, and shake. Remove breaded okra to a plate. Repeat with remaining okra slices.

Preheat air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Place 1/2 the breaded okra slices in the basket of the air fryer and spray with cooking spray. Cook 4 minutes. Shake the basket and mist okra with cooking spray again. Cook an additional 4 minutes. Shake the basket one last time and cook for 2 minutes. Remove the okra from the basket and salt to taste.

video.description: In this video, Nicole shows you three deliciously different ways to cook okra. These recipes use an air-fryer, oven, and stove to roast and fry the southern favorite veggie. To roast in the oven, place the prepared okra on a baking sheet and coat with oil before roasting. Air-frying the okra uses cooking spray, an egg coating, and cornmeal to crisp and cook the pods. Check out the video to see how to make these crispy southern sides!
